notes: Matches come from RSSSF's list (updated to 2025), with the 1 played since from Spanish Wikipedia; knockout ties and totals from Wikipedia.
Matches decided on penalties count as draws; the shoot-out decides only who went through.
The source's own totals table counts 235 official matches (91–80–64); the match list adds up to 234 (89–81–64).
The top scorers are counted from the scorers listed for each match (200 of the 206 matches with goals have them), so they may differ slightly from other sources.
